disposition: Two-step deterministic routing (shard key to bucket to shard to owner at an epoch), seating validation, epoch-fenced view transitions, tenant isolation across shards, sharded query fan-out, and public V1-shaped document routing are focused-tested. V2 routing is server-side by architecture (no client request executor); prefixed routing and sticky ids are structurally refused and recorded as needing a new decision in src/sharding/mod.rs.
